steps.en: Staff signs in and reaches the access control system
steps.id: Staff masuk dan sampai ke sistem kontrol akses
steps.why_en: Any user with system access can open the page by address; only the menu is role-specific
steps.why_id: User yang punya akses sistem bisa membuka halaman lewat alamat; hanya menu yang dibatasi role

steps.en: Only administrators see the Manage Roles menu
steps.id: Hanya administrator yang melihat menu Manage Roles
steps.why_en: Hidden only on screen; the system behind it does not check the role
steps.why_id: Hanya disembunyikan di layar; sistem di belakangnya tidak mengecek role

steps.en: Staff sees a table of all roles
Staff can search roles by ID or name
steps.id: Staff bisa mencari role berdasarkan ID atau nama

steps.en: Staff can sort the role list by ID or name
steps.id: Staff bisa mengurutkan daftar role berdasarkan ID atau nama
steps.why_en: Only a fixed sort by name exists; users cannot click to sort
steps.why_id: Hanya ada urutan tetap berdasarkan nama; user tidak bisa klik untuk mengurutkan

steps.en: Staff can export the role list to a spreadsheet
steps.id: Staff bisa mengekspor daftar role ke spreadsheet

steps.en: Add New Role opens a form with all role fields
steps.id: Add New Role membuka form dengan semua field role
steps.why_en: The URL field in the spec is missing from the form
steps.why_id: Field URL di spesifikasi tidak ada di form

steps.en: Submitting the form saves the new role
Editing a role changes only its description
steps.why_en: Enforced only on screen; the system accepts a changed role name
steps.why_id: Hanya ditegakkan di layar; sistem menerima perubahan nama role

steps.en: Staff confirms in a pop-up before deleting a role
steps.id: Staff konfirmasi di pop-up sebelum menghapus role

steps.en: A role in use by users cannot be deleted and shows an error
steps.id: Role yang dipakai user tidak bisa dihapus dan muncul pesan error

steps.en: Staff sees an error pop-up if loading or saving fails
steps.id: Staff melihat pop-up error jika memuat atau menyimpan gagal
steps.why_en: The message is generic and hides the real cause such as a duplicate ID
steps.why_id: Pesannya generik dan menyembunyikan penyebab asli seperti ID duplikat
